title: Monitoring Continuity Reduction for ClearPath Reinstatements
content:
The monitoring-continuity reduction of the reinstatement fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the client's active Sentinel Managed Security subscription:
- a subscription whose tier includes threat hunting takes 20 percent off;
- an active subscription whose tier does not takes 10 percent off;
- no active subscription takes nothing off.

Whether threat hunting is included is a feature of the tier of the client's Sentinel Managed Security subscription whose status is active.

**Points of judgement.**
- The client's active Sentinel subscription is on a tier with threat hunting: 20 percent off the reinstatement fee.
- Its tier has no threat hunting: 10 percent off.
- The client's Sentinel subscription is not active, or there is none: no reduction.
